title: Resultant Height
body: Two sinusoidal waves are moving through a medium in the positive $$x\$\$-direction$$, $$both$$ $$having$$ $$amplitudes$$ $$of$$ $$7.00\, \text{cm}$$, $$a$$ $$wave$$ $$number$$ $$of$$ $$k=3.00\, \tfrac{\text{rad}}{\text{m}}$$, $$an$$ $$angular$$ $$frequency$$ $$of$$ $$\omega=2.50\, \tfrac{\text{rad}}{\text{s}}$$, $$and$$ $$a$$ $$period$$ $$of$$ $$6.00\, \text{s}$$, $$but$$ $$one$$ $$has$$ $$a$$ $$phase$$ $$shift$$ $$of$$ $$an$$ $$angle$$ $$\phi=pi/12\,\text{rad}$$.
